title: 第1章 夜车
slug: 灵棺夜行全本免费-灵棺夜行最新章节列表
content_zh:
这晚我跟师傅开着面包车来到李家坳，看到路口有一个穿着红色衣服的女人在拦车。
我感觉很奇怪，因为已经12点多了。
这个点，怎么还会有人拦车？虽说心里觉的奇怪，但有钱没道理不挣。
我正要停车，睡在副驾驶的师傅突然醒来：“不要停，今天不拉客了。”
我心里纳闷，师傅今天是怎么啦，转性了？
为了多拉一位客人十几二十分钟他都会等，这送上门的生意居然不做，但师傅的话我不敢不听，乖乖的哦了一声。
我没有停车，破旧的面包车从红衣女子身前开过去时，还是忍不住看了她一眼。
她很漂亮，五官精致，身上流露出一股难得的古典贵气。
她站在原地，目光注视着我，她的眼眸很黑，很亮，瞳光闪闪。
见我并没有停车的意思，她动了动嘴唇，最终还是没有开口，但眼中却充满了幽怨，这种眼神让我心生不忍。
我忍不住说道：“师傅，拉上她吧，能多挣一份车钱呢。”
师傅瞪了我一眼，凶巴巴的道：“让你别拉就别拉，废什么话，再废话你明天就不用来了。”
见师傅发火，我吓的不敢再多说，老老实实的往前开。
可心里始终吊着刚才那个红衣女人，她那幽怨的眼神总是挥之不去。
下意识的通过观后镜往后看，这只是下意识的动作，可没想，又看到了那个女人，她还站在后面，她对着我浅浅一笑，笑的很矜持。
我是个野小子，但偏偏喜欢大家闺秀，嘴角不自觉的裂开了微笑。
咦，不对啊！
我看了下车速，六十码往上走，而且早就过了李家坳的路口了，她怎么还在后面？！
瞬时间，我头皮发麻，全身寒毛倒竖了起来。
不是吧！

我吓的魂都飞出去了，鼓起勇气再定睛看了一下观后镜，后方黑压压一片，哪里有什么女人。
原来看花眼了。
又开了几分钟，我又习惯性的去看观后镜。
这一看，彻底把我吓的大声起来！
那个红衣女人再一次出现在观后镜里，她还站在路边痴痴的等着，好像一个妻子在等待丈夫归来。
师傅被我的惊叫声惊醒：“阿瞳，怎么啦？”
我整张脸都吓白了，哆嗦着说道：“我……我，我又看见那个红衣女人了。”
师傅听了也脸色大变，慌忙道：“不要回头，不要再去看她，快，快往前开。”
不是我孬，大半夜的你在荒郊野外开车遇上这种事情，你未必比我好多少。
我快速拐过前方的路口，师傅让我把车子开到树坳里去。
虽然我不明白师傅为什么让我把车开进路边的树坳里，但我还是不假思索的就开了进去。
待车子开进树坳，师傅就让我熄火关灯。
师傅翻开副驾驶位的抽屉，从里面拿出两根白蜡烛，嘱咐我说：“呆在车上，别说话，更不能大声叫。”
我机械的点了点头，我已经吓的六神无主，师傅说什么就是什么。
师傅拿着两根蜡烛下了车，往马路当中走去。
我目光注视着来的方向，生怕那个女人会突然出现，一颗心嘣嘣的狂跳不止，紧张的都快窒息了。
师傅走到马路当中，拿着蜡烛比划了几下，好像在辨认方向，然后蹲了下去。
他把两根蜡烛摆放在柏油路上，掏出火柴盒，给点上了。
深夜，两根蜡烛点在马路当中看起来真的很诡异。
我想大家也一定在马路上看见过白蜡烛，有的还被汽车碾碎，我也是，以前我一直以为是有人不小心掉的，但现在看来不是那么回事。

师傅点完蜡烛，就跑了回来。
师傅对我说：“夜车开多了，难免会遇上奇怪的事情，但是不要怕，人不犯我，我不犯人，你看到我点的蜡烛了吧，这叫‘指路灯’，不是给我们指路，而是给他们指路，说白了，给他们指一条错误的路。”
我有些发懵的点了下头。
师傅抬起手腕看了下时间，一刻钟：“她会在这里绕一刻钟，如果找不到路就会离开。”
我又机械的点了点头，我有点吓傻了。
一刻钟也就是十五分钟，这十五分钟绝逼比一年还要久。
我跟师傅缩在面包车里，又惊又怕，不时的望向路中的那对点燃的蜡烛。
千万不要被风吹熄了。
如果蜡烛被风给吹熄了，后果可想而知……
也许是我走运，夜里一般风都挺大，但今夜不知道是怎么啦，非常闷热，却没什么风。

content_en:
That night my master and I drove a van to Lijia'ao and saw a woman in red clothes blocking the bus at the intersection.
I felt weird because it was already past 12 o'clock.
At this point, why would anyone stop the car? Although I feel strange in my heart, there is no reason not to make money.
I was about to park the car when the driver who was sleeping in the passenger seat suddenly woke up and said, "Don't stop, we won't be soliciting customers today."
I was wondering, what happened to Master today? Did he change his gender?
He would wait for more than ten or twenty minutes just to get one more customer, but he actually refused to do the door-to-door business. But I didn’t dare not listen to the master’s words, so I said obediently.
I didn't stop the car. When the dilapidated van drove past the woman in red, I couldn't help but glance at her.
She is very beautiful, with exquisite facial features and a rare classical nobility exuding from her body.
She stood there, staring at me, her eyes were very dark, very bright, and her pupils were shining.
Seeing that I had no intention of stopping, she moved her lips, but in the end she didn't speak, but her eyes were full of resentment. This look made me unbearable.
I couldn't help but said: "Master, take her with you. You can earn more money for the car."
The master glared at me and said fiercely: "Don't pull it if I ask you not to. If you talk nonsense, you won't come tomorrow if you keep talking nonsense."
Seeing the master getting angry, I was too scared to say anything more and drove forward honestly.
But the woman in red just now is always hanging in my heart, and her resentful eyes are always lingering.
I subconsciously looked back through the rear mirror. This was just a subconscious action. But without thinking, I saw the woman again. She was still standing behind me. She smiled lightly at me, her smile was very reserved.
I am a wild boy, but I like everyone to be pretty, and the corners of my mouth split into a smile unconsciously.
Hey, that’s not right!
I checked the speed of the car and saw that I was walking up sixty yards and had already passed the intersection of Lijia'ao. Why was she still behind? !
Instantly, my scalp became numb and the hairs all over my body stood up.
No!
I was so frightened that I flew out. I mustered up the courage to look in the rearview mirror again. It was completely dark behind me, and there was no woman anywhere.
It turned out that it was a dazzling sight.
After driving for a few more minutes, I habitually looked in the rear mirror.
This sight completely frightened me out loud!
The woman in red appeared in the rearview mirror again. She was still standing on the side of the road waiting impatiently, like a wife waiting for her husband to return.
The master was awakened by my scream: "A Tong, what's wrong?"
My whole face turned pale with fright, and I trembled and said, "I...I, I saw the woman in red again."
The master's expression changed greatly after hearing this, and he hurriedly said: "Don't look back, don't look at her again, hurry up, hurry up and drive forward."
It's not that I'm stupid. If you encounter this kind of thing while driving in the wilderness in the middle of the night, you may not be much better than me.
I quickly turned the intersection ahead, and the master asked me to drive the car into the tree col.
Although I didn't understand why the master asked me to drive the car into the tree hollow on the roadside, I drove in without thinking.
When the car drove into Shu'ao, the master asked me to turn off the engine and turn off the lights.
The master opened the drawer of the passenger seat, took out two white candles from it, and told me: "Stay in the car, don't talk, and don't shout too loudly."
I nodded mechanically. I was so frightened that whatever the master said was whatever I wanted.
The master got out of the car with two candles and walked towards the road.
I stared at the direction I was coming from, fearing that the woman would suddenly appear. My heart was beating wildly, and I was so nervous that I almost suffocated.
The master walked to the middle of the road, gestured with the candle a few times, as if to identify the direction, and then squatted down.
He placed the two candles on the asphalt, took out the matchbox, and lit them.
It looks really weird with two candles lit in the middle of the road late at night.
I think you must have seen white wax on the road.Some of the candles were crushed by cars, and so was I. I used to think that someone accidentally dropped them, but now it seems that's not the case.
After the master lit the candle, he ran back.
The master said to me: "If you drive too much at night, you will inevitably encounter strange things, but don't be afraid. I will not offend anyone unless they offend me. You have seen the candles I lit. They are called 'guiding lights'. They are not showing us the way, but showing them the way. To put it bluntly, they are pointing the wrong way."
I nodded in confusion.
The master raised his wrist and looked at the time, a quarter of an hour: "She will be here for a quarter of an hour. If she can't find the way, she will leave."
I nodded mechanically again, I was a little scared.
A quarter of an hour is also fifteen minutes. These fifteen minutes are definitely longer than a year.
The master and I huddled in the van, frightened and frightened, and we looked at the pair of lit candles on the road from time to time.
Don't let the wind blow you out.
If the candle is blown out by the wind, the consequences can be imagined...
Maybe I'm lucky. The wind is usually quite strong at night, but I don't know what happened tonight. It was very hot and muggy, but there was no wind.
